done_when: While a child close waits only for checks, land --all releases its slot so another item can start, keeping stack and shared-file order, and a test shows a waiting child does not block a new close

known.title: Forward the check-slot callback through the behind-base retry

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. The previous finding remains unfixed. Conflict recovery forwards `check_slot` here, but the behind-base recovery at src/forge/merge.py:130–133 still omits it. When another PR advances main and GitHub rejects the merge as BEHIND, the refreshed close waits for its new checks with `slot=None` (src/forge/close.py:427–430). It holds its queue slot throughout running CI, blocking independent closes when the queue is saturated. Forward `check_slot` through that recovery Namespace too.
findings.title: Forward the check-slot callback through the behind-base retry
